run_demo_visualization: run demo visualization on video frames using a config and frame provider iterator
demo_inference: run inference on an input video or webcam stream with SlowFast model predictions
create_video_visualizer: create a VideoVisualizer with class names, thresholds, top-k predictions, and colormap settings
create_async_demo: create an AsyncDemo predictor for multi-GPU video inference with async visualization workers
create_video_manager: create a VideoManager or ThreadVideoManager to load and provide frames for demo inference
